label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3 a.1…: Whatever is being moved in a respect is moved in that…
locator: I q.3 a.1 co., second proof: quia quod est in potentia, non reducitur in actum nisi per ens actu
interpretation: The reason Aquinas gives for act's simple priority over potency: what is in potency is reduced to act only by a being in act. Read as the same principle as the prima via's 'nisi per aliquod ens in actu': whatever is being reduced to act in a respect is reduced by something in act in that respect. The inference from this reason to simple priority is not part of the claim; BEING-IN-ACT-READING-FACTS shows that the reason alone does not yield it, because a being can be in potency in a respect in which nothing is being reduced.
